docs.title: RobCo Industries Hacking Game
docs.text: Welcome to the RobCo Industries Hacking Game, an NCurses-based terminal game inspired by the hacking mechanic from the Fallout series. Test your deduction skills by guessing the correct word from a scrambled list within a limited number of attempts.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Interactive Gameplay: Navigate through panels of scrambled text and make your guess.
  • Color-Coded Feedback:
  • Selected words are highlighted.
  • Incorrect guesses remain visible in a distinct color.
  • Word Similarity Feedback: After each incorrect guess, see how many letters matched the correct solution.
  • Randomized Layout: Every game generates a unique set of scrambled words and panels.
  • Customizable Parameters: Adjust the number of panels, rows, columns, and words via command-line arguments.

docs.title: Gameplay
docs.text:
1. Objective: Find the correct password hidden among scrambled words.
  2. Navigation:
  3. Use the arrow keys to move the cursor.
  4. Press Enter or Mouse Click to select a word.
  5. Feedback:
  6. Correct guesses win the game.
  7. Incorrect guesses reduce your attempts and show matching letters.
  8. Game Over: The game ends when you either guess the correct word or run out of attempts.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A C++ compiler supporting C++17 or later.
  • NCurses library installed on your system.

docs.title: Build Instructions
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository:
git clone https://github.com/username/robco-hacking-game.git
cd robco-hacking-game
  1. Create a build directory and navigate into it:
mkdir build && cd build
  1. Build the project:
cmake ..
make
  1. Run the game:
./robsec --dictionary ../data/words.txt -p 4 -r 15 -c 15 -w 15

docs.title: Command-Line Arguments
docs.text:
The game accepts several configuration options via the command line:

Argument Alias Default Description --dictionary -d None Path to the dictionary file. --panels -p 3 Number of panels. --rows -r 20 Number of rows per panel. --columns -c 12 Number of columns per panel. --words -w 12 Number of words to guess. --attempts -a 4 Number of attempts allowed.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
To run the game with a custom configuration:

./robsec --dictionary ../data/words.txt -p 4 -r 15 -c 15 -w 15

docs.title: Key Bindings
docs.text: Key Action Arrow Keys Navigate through panels Enter Select a word q Quit the game

docs.title: Code Structure
docs.text:
• game.hpp: Contains the game logic, structures, and rendering functions.
  • main.cpp: Initializes the game and handles execution flow.
  • utils.cpp: Helper functions for random number generation, string manipulation, etc.

docs.title: Known Issues
docs.text:
• Transparent background support may vary depending on the terminal emulator.
  • Mouse functionality is not supported on all terminals.

docs.title: Acknowledgments
docs.text:
• Inspired by the hacking mechanic from the Fallout series.
  • Built with the NCurses library for terminal-based UI.
